name: print-social-cake-of-the-week-menu-post-with-blobbed-cutouts
title: Cobalt 'CAKE of the Week' menu with four cutout cakes on rough coloured halos
whatItIs: A cobalt post with a huge white wavy 'CAKE' and 'of the Week', four cake photos each outlined by a rough halo in a matching colour (caramel, pink, green, cream), names in bold and short descriptions in light text, white doodle squiggles, and a small logo.
whatItMeans: Warm, appetising and playful; matching halos tie every cake to its flavour.
techniques: Give each cutout a rough halo in a colour drawn from the food.
Set an oversized title in a wavy display face.
Scatter squiggle lines to suggest motion.
Pair bold names with light descriptions.

vocabulary.definition: A rough shape behind a cutout in a matching hue.
A short doodle line suggesting motion.
A post listing items with names and descriptions.
